content:
maria_ops: Quick heads-up — Evans Logistics reported a hold on the EU top-up wave. 20x H100s scheduled for FRA-DC3, but 4 units are DOA and 2 have serial mismatch flags. Vendor opened an RMA and customs requested photo + invoice copies. ETA drift ~5-7 days if we consolidate sea, ~1-2 days for air on subset. Need routing + cost-share decision ASAP.

vendor_evans: sorry about the hit, really unusual. RMA ref EV-98432 created. We can:
- expedite 6 units by air (next-flight) at +$11.5k/unit (freight + insurance)
- consolidate remaining 14 on sea (no extra freight) but customs hold could add 3-5 days.
We need photo proof of DOA to process warranty claim (send to returns@evans). Can we approve partial air?

maria_ops: @vendor_evans please attach the photo links inline in the thread. Also include the AWB numbers for the candidate air units. We need a concrete cost/benefit so procurement can sign off.

vendor_evans: Uploaded photos and AWBs: air AWB: 125-EEV-8901,125-EEV-8902,125-EEV-8903. Sea manifest snippet: MAN-FRA-20250319-43. Photos: https://files.evans/EV-98432/photos.zip

kevin_logistics: If we split air/sea we should consolidate paperwork to a single FRA-DC3 intake to avoid double handling. Suggest replicating this manifest update to our DC intake tool: 
```
POST /manifests/update
{ "manifest_id": "MAN-FRA-20250319-43", "split_air": ["125-EEV-8901","125-EEV-8902","125-EEV-8903","125-EEV-8904","125-EEV-8905","125-EEV-8906"], "destination": "FRA-DC3" }
```
Ops note: FRA-DC3 can handle 6 immediate air arrivals for staging.

dan_supply: Cost math quick pass:
- Air expedite 6 units = 6 * $11,500 = $69,000
- Customs brokerage + priority handling ~ $2,400 total
- Sea holds risk = 3 extra days downtime (for customers relying on EU capacity). Estimated revenue impact = ~$25k/day * 3 = $75k (soft).
Given that, approving 6 air units looks defensible. Recommend cost-share 50/50 vendor vs. Redwood for expedite. Vendor to credit warranty claim for DOA units once RMA validated.

maria_ops: Sounds reasonable. @vendor_evans can you accept 50% expedite surcharge? Also confirm RMA SLA for refund/replacement turnaround after we ship evidence.

vendor_evans: Can accept 50% on expedite for this wave (we'll absorb rest). RMA SLA: 10 business days to validate and issue replacement credit after receiving DOA evidence. For serial mismatch we need origin manifest to trace — that adds ~2 business days.

rma_bot: RMA ticket created: EV-98432-01. Status: evidence_requested -> photos uploaded -> awaiting validation. Link: https://rma.evans/EV-98432-01

kevin_logistics: One more logistics ask — to minimize customs friction, can we send a short cover letter declaring replacement/DOA status and attach original commercial invoice? If legal approves, we can clear customs faster.

maria_ops: Good call. @dan_supply please create PO addendum with 50% expedite cost line item and attach original invoices. Kevin, coordinate DC booking for FRA-DC3 for two arrival windows (air next-flight, sea ETA +6 days). I'll file a ticket with legal for the cover letter template.

dan_supply: On it. Creating PO addendum now and pinging finance for pre-approval. ETA for PO update: 90m.

maria_ops: OK proceeding with split plan: approve air for 6 units, rest sea. Vendor to absorb partial expedite cost per agreement. Kevin/Dan to coordinate AWB handoff and PO addendum. I'll monitor RMA EV-98432-01. Thanks :thumbsup:
